intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre community activity.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about community activity.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Join our park cleanup this Saturday. We meet beside the playground at ten o’clock. Bring gloves if you have them. The organisers will provide bags and small tools. First, we collect paper near the lake. Then we clean the picnic tables. At noon, everyone can share fruit and juice in the community room. Children must come with an adult.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Join our park cleanup this Saturday. We meet beside the playground at ten o’clock. Bring gloves if you have them. The organisers will provide bags and small tools. First, we collect paper near the lake. Then we clean the picnic tables. At noon, everyone can share fruit and juice in the community room. Children must come with an adult.
